data.exact_reserve_text: Prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k, taking the total due from members and the Lloyd's Central Fund (LCF) to GBP 45,158k, this amount was settled during the financial year. Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves totaling GBP 118.75 million in 2016. This was primarily driven by adverse claims development across multiple underwriting years, with specific mention of a GBP 5.833 million strengthening for the 2007 underwriting year related to Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves. The overall loss experience was worse than anticipated, leading to a general strengthening of reserves to reflect this experience.
